verses.en: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.
verses.pt: Ora, os anos da vida de Sara foram cento e vinte e sete.
verses.en_web: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.
verses.en_bbe: Now the years of Sarah's life were a hundred and twenty-seven.

verses.en: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
verses.pt: E morreu Sara em Quiriate-Arba, que é Hebrom, na terra de Canaã; e veio Abraão lamentá-la e chorar por ela:
verses.en_web: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
verses.en_bbe: And Sarah's death took place in Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron, in the land of Canaan: and Abraham went into his house, weeping and sorrowing for Sarah.

verses.en: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,
verses.pt: Depois se levantou Abraão de diante do seu morto, e falou aos filhos de Hete, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Abraham rose up from before his dead, and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham came from his dead and said to the children of Heth,

verses.en: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
verses.pt: Estrangeiro e peregrino sou eu entre vós; dai-me o direito de um lugar de sepultura entre vós, para que eu sepulte o meu morto, removendo-o de diante da minha face.
verses.en_web: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”
verses.en_bbe: I am living among you as one from a strange country: give me some land here as my property, so that I may put my dead to rest.

verses.en: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,
verses.pt: Responderam-lhe os filhos de Hete:
verses.en_web: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,
verses.en_bbe: And in answer the children of Heth said to Abraham,

verses.en: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
verses.pt: Ouve-nos, senhor; príncipe de Deus és tu entre nós; enterra o teu morto na mais escolhida de nossas sepulturas; nenhum de nós te vedará a sua sepultura, para enterrares o teu morto.
verses.en_web: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”
verses.en_bbe: My lord, truly you are a great chief among us; take the best of our resting-places for your dead; not one of us will keep back from you a place where you may put your dead to rest.

verses.en: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
verses.pt: Então se levantou Abraão e, inclinando-se diante do povo da terra, diante dos filhos de Hete,
verses.en_web: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham got up and gave honour to the children of Heth, the people of that land.

verses.en: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
verses.pt: falou-lhes, dizendo: Se é de vossa vontade que eu sepulte o meu morto de diante de minha face, ouvi-me e intercedei por mim junto a Efrom, filho de Zoar,
verses.en_web: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, If you will let me put my dead to rest here, make a request for me to Ephron, the son of Zohar,

verses.en: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.
verses.pt: para que ele me dê a cova de Macpela, que possui no fim do seu campo; que ma dê pelo devido preço em posse de sepulcro no meio de vós.
verses.en_web: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him give it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”
verses.en_bbe: That he will give me the hollow in the rock named Machpelah, which is his property at the end of his field; let him give it to me for its full price as a resting-place for my dead among you.

verses.en: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
verses.pt: Ora, Efrom estava sentado no meio dos filhos de Hete; e respondeu Efrom, o heteu, a Abraão, aos ouvidos dos filhos de Hete, isto é, de todos os que entravam pela porta da sua cidade, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Now Ephron was seated among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite gave Abraham his answer in the hearing of the children of Heth, and of all those who came into his town, saying,

verses.en: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.
verses.pt: Não, meu senhor; ouve-me. O campo te dou, também te dou a cova que nele está; na presença dos filhos do meu povo ta dou; sepulta o teu morto.
verses.en_web: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”
verses.en_bbe: No, my lord, I will give you the field with the hollow in the rock; before all the children of my people will I give it to you for a resting-place for your dead.

verses.en: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.
verses.pt: Então Abraão se inclinou diante do povo da terra,
verses.en_web: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham went down on his face before the people of the land.

verses.en: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
verses.pt: e falou a Efrom, aos ouvidos do povo da terra, dizendo: Se te agrada, peço-te que me ouças. Darei o preço do campo; toma-o de mim, e sepultarei ali o meu morto.
verses.en_web: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham said to Ephron, in the hearing of the people of the land, If only you will give ear to me, I will give you the price of the field; take it, and let me put my dead to rest there.

verses.en: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,
verses.pt: Respondeu Efrom a Abraão:
verses.en_web: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,
verses.en_bbe: So Ephron said to Abraham,

verses.en: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.
verses.pt: Meu senhor, ouve-me. Um terreno do valor de quatrocentos siclos de prata! que é isto entre mim e ti? Sepulta, pois, o teu morto.
verses.en_web: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”
verses.en_bbe: My lord, give ear to me: the value of the land is four hundred shekels; what is that between me and you? so put your dead to rest there.

verses.en: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
verses.pt: E Abraão ouviu a Efrom, e pesou-lhe a prata de que este tinha falado aos ouvidos dos filhos de Hete, quatrocentos siclos de prata, moeda corrente entre os mercadores.
verses.en_web: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the audience of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham took note of the price fixed by Ephron in the hearing of the children of Heth, and gave him four hundred shekels in current money.

verses.en: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure
verses.pt: Assim o campo de Efrom, que estava em Macpela, em frente de Manre, o campo e a cova que nele estava, e todo o arvoredo que havia nele, por todos os seus limites ao redor, se confirmaram
verses.en_web: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded
verses.en_bbe: So Ephron's field at Machpelah near Mamre, with the hollow in the rock and all the trees in the field and round it,

verses.en: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
verses.pt: a Abraão em possessão na presença dos filhos de Hete, isto é, de todos os que entravam pela porta da sua cidade.
verses.en_web: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.
verses.en_bbe: Became the property of Abraham before the eyes of the children of Heth and of all who came into the town.

verses.en: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
verses.pt: Depois sepultou Abraão a Sara sua mulher na cova do campo de Macpela, em frente de Manre, que é Hebrom, na terra de Canaã.
verses.en_web: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.
verses.en_bbe: Then Abraham put Sarah his wife to rest in the hollow rock in the field of Machpelah near Mamre, that is, Hebron in the land of Canaan.

verses.en: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.
verses.pt: Assim o campo e a cova que nele estava foram confirmados a Abraão pelos filhos de Hete em possessão de sepultura.
verses.en_web: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.
verses.en_bbe: And the field and the hollow rock were handed over to Abraham as his property by the children of Heth.
